source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: US Department of Health and Human Services Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), 5 A Day for Better Health Program

ingredients.name: green peppers, chopped (or red, yellow or orange peppers)

steps.instruction: Put 4 cups of spinach and 4 cups of romaine lettuce in a large mixing bowl.
Add 2 cups of chopped green peppers and 2 cups of cherry tomatoes.
Add 1 cup each of chopped broccoli and chopped cauliflower.
Add 1 cup each of sliced yellow squash and sliced cucumber.
Add 2 cups of chopped carrot and 1 cup of sliced zucchini.
Top with the nonfat or low-fat dressing of your choice.
